 Travel
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircraft
Three flights on September 11, 2023:
Yellowknife to Fort Smith
Fort Smith to Hay River
Hay River to Yellowknife
Offered by the government of Northwest Territories.
Circumstances:
I accompanied a minister of the Northwest Territories to visit communities impacted by wildfires in the territories.
This travel was required in my capacity as Minister of Emergency Preparedness.
Members of ministerial staff in attendance:
Andrew Green, Regional Advisor and Communications Advisor
Daniel Pereira, Communications Assistant and Photographer
 Travel on a non-commercial chartered or private aircarft
Three flights in British Columbia on August 22, 2023:
Vancouver to Kamloops.
Kamloops to Penticton.
Penticton to Vancouver.
Offered by the government of British Columbia.
Circumstances:
I was invited by the Premier of British Columbia and British Columbia’s Minister of Emergency Management and Climate Readiness to visit communities impacted by wildfires in the province.
This travel was required in my capacity as Minister of Emergency Preparedness.
